newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSAPANK LOOKS FOR FOREIGN PARTNERS.
newsitem.headline: HANSAPANK LOOKS FOR FOREIGN PARTNERS.

text.p: Estonia's Hansapank said on Monday that it is looking for foreign partners to ensure its development strategy as it attempts to move into the Lithuanian market.
"To ensure a fully financed development strategy, Hansapank is looking for a possible strategic investor amoung the larger international banks," the bank said in a statement.
"In 1997 it is our intention to expand to the Lithuanian banking sector," the bank added.
However, the bank said that it will not subject itself to any agreements that change its current strategy.

"Hansapank has no intention to bind itself by contracts which would force it to change the current development stategy," the bank said. --David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom +372 620 9201/2 reuters@reuters.ee
